description: The figure contains two separate vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss’ Kappa values as a function of ambiguity-related category levels, with each bar annotated by its numeric value. In the left chart, the horizontal axis lists Ambiguity Std categories in the order 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94 (categorical positions rather than a continuous scale), and the vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” on a linear scale from 0.0 up to just under 0.9 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The four bars are shaded in a blue gradient (darker for the leftmost bar and lighter toward the right): Ambiguity Std 0.0 is approximately 0.88, 0.47 is approximately 0.46, 0.82 is approximately 0.03, and 0.94 is approximately 0.24. In the right chart, the horizontal axis lists Max Ambiguity categories 1, 2, and 3 in increasing order, and the vertical axis is again labeled “Fleiss Kappa” with the same linear scaling and tick spacing (0.0 to just under 0.9, ticks every 0.2). The three bars (also in blue shades) have annotated values of approximately 0.89 for Max Ambiguity 1, 0.46 for 2, and 0.23 for 3; there is no legend, no stacking or grouping beyond the separate panels, and no additional visual emphasis besides the value labels above each bar.
